title: Grays turning into owls in close encounter cases

tellings.quote: cases where people say they saw um grays turn into owls

plain: There are cases where people say they saw grays, the small gray-skinned beings often described in alien encounter stories, turn into owls. A researcher named Jason Jorjani mentions this in passing, pointing to a researcher named Mike Cleland and a work called Closer Encounters. If true, it would suggest these beings can change the form in which they appear to people.
